# MBO packetization vector (spec/10-accounts-risk-md.md §7.3, §7.4). Generated by an
# independent Python script that builds each packet by hand from the spec, not by an encoder.
#
# Input: `book`, `epoch`, then one `ev <rx_ts> <kind> ...` per replayed event, then `end` (the
# epoch ends). Kinds, integers decimal or 0x-hex, side 0 buy / 1 sell, flags 0/1:
#   lane add <oid> <side> <tick> <qty> <prio_ts> <via_bbo> <auction>
#   lane del <oid> <cause> <tick> <qty>
#   lane reduce <oid> <tick> <qty_after>
#   stepop add ... (as lane add)
#   step <step> <kind> <n_exec> <taker>
#   exec <aggressor side> <ordinal> <maker oid> <tick> <qty>
#   tick
# Output: `pkt <hex>`, every packet in emission order. Then `order <oid> <side> <tick> <qty>
# <prio_ts>`: the book a subscriber holds after the epoch, in oid order.
